title: Four outside groups will sit inside OpenAI. Reports can still wait.
friendlyTitle: Four outside groups will work inside OpenAI. Their reports can wait.
summary: On 16 November, OpenAI said it signed agreements with Apollo Research, METR, Transluce, and Goodfire for on-site assessments of alignment and safeguards. Depending on the scope, assessors can see internal checkpoints, code, training data, and monitoring records, and sensitive work is done on OpenAI devices.
friendlySummary: On 16 November, OpenAI said it signed deals with Apollo Research, METR, Transluce, and Goodfire. They will review safety and whether models follow their instructions, on site. Depending on the job, they can see internal models, code, training data, and monitoring records. Sensitive work is done on OpenAI computers.
whyItMatters: OpenAI says it can redact confidential details and ask for a delay before publication so it can fix a safety or security finding. Apollo and Goodfire are paid, not by the result. METR and Transluce are not paid, and may receive compute. A signed agreement is not a published audit.
